Fun for All at Peach Harvest Festival
By Dean Keller
August 14—Saturday is Brookdale Farm's fifteenth annual Peach Harvest Festival.
This year the festival will feature headlining bands Valley Lizard and Squash the
Stagecoach, which will close the event with performances at 7:30 and 9:00 P.M.,
respectively. In addition to musical performances, the beloved local festival features
peach-themed contests and games, various food vendors, and artists from across
the region. The festival starts at noon, and main-stage performances begin at
2:00 P.M. with local singing group Graceful Basses. Other afternoon acts include
Cherry Heights and Manor Mercury. QYTV News contributors Adriana Ochoa and
Kieran Allison will report live from the festival grounds. Tickets can be purchased
online at www.peachharvestfestival.com/tickets.

Subject:
Peach Harvest Festival
To Whom It May Concern,
My family attended the Peach Harvest Festival on Saturday. On the evening news the day
before the festival, the meteorologist discussed the likelihood of rain on Saturday,
including the specific times when rain was expected. This information was incredibly
helpful; we brought ponchos and wore warm rain boots to the festival, and they served us
well. Thank you so much for the thorough, accurate weather forecasting.
Sincerely,
Tessa Crane
